Fields.Name: Property Bag
Fields.Description: Havok's attached properties (not used by the games).

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: Listeners
Fields.Description: Objects told when the state is entered or left.

Fields.Name: Enter Notify Events
Fields.Description: Events sent when the state is entered.

Fields.Name: Exit Notify Events
Fields.Description: Events sent when the state is left.

Fields.Name: Transitions
Fields.Description: The transitions out of this state, each started by an event.

Fields.Name: Generator
Fields.Description: The generator that plays while this state is active.

Fields.Name: State ID
Fields.Description: The state's ID, which transitions and the Start State refer to. Unique within its state machine.

Fields.Name: Probability
Fields.Description: The state's weight when a random state is picked (Random Transition Event, or the Random start state mode).

Fields.Name: Enable
Fields.Description: Whether the state can be entered. A transition into a disabled state is ignored.
